about: The track's one map: tiles of TILE pixels a side, at every level (level 0 the whole precision, each next half the one before), named <level>/<column>_<row>.jpg; north up, west on the left, the map's middle at x = z = 0 (a pixel's column (span/2 - x) / metres_a_pixel, its row (span/2 - z) / metres_a_pixel).
